name: 4D Ecosystem & Dependency Spillover
description: Trades downstream enterprise beneficiaries and component suppliers when tier-1 buyers commit capex or upstream suppliers encounter bottlenecks.
risk_rules: Requires ecosystem contagion score > +55; max 5% portfolio allocation.

name: Deterministic Non-LLM Risk Gate & ATR Bracket
description: Sizes positions based on ATR volatility ( risk / 1.5 ATR), caps single-ticker exposure at 5%, and enforces mathematical stop-loss and profit target brackets.
risk_rules: Mandatory Stop < Entry < Target; Minimum 1.5:1 Risk/Reward ratio.

name: Adversarial Tribunal Dialectical Synthesis
description: Requires Bull Advocate and Bear Adversary to cross-examine catalysts. Chief Judge magistrate synthesizes dialectical thesis; only orders with conviction > 75 execute.
risk_rules: Minimum 2 Bull arguments and 2 Bear counter-arguments required; confirmation bias penalization.

name: SEC EDGAR 10-K & Form 4 Insider Cluster Flow
description: Scans SEC EDGAR 10-K Item 1A Risk Factors and tracks C-suite executive Form 4 insider purchasing clusters ($>500K) as high-conviction catalysts.
risk_rules: Blocks tickers with late SEC filings; flags executive selling clusters.

name: Macro Yield Regime & FRED Telemetry Hedging
description: Shifts capital allocation between defensive dividend leaders and high-beta tech based on FRED 10Y-2Y Treasury spread, CPI inflation, and VIX volatility regime.
risk_rules: Scales down equity allocation by 50% when VIX > 25.0 or 10Y yield surges > 20bps in 5 days.
